symbols.name: precision unit
symbols.meaning: $2^{-p}$, the size of one unit in the last place of a stored value.
symbols.quote: Write $h_p = 2^{-p}$ for the size of one unit in the last place of a stored value; an error of $a$ units is an absolute error below $a\,h_p$.

symbols.name: log of box size
symbols.meaning: $\log_2 T$, the base-two logarithm of the padded box size $T$.
symbols.quote: Here $T$ counts the entries of the [Padded transform box](padded-transform-box.md), a power of two in $[4n/b, 8n/b)$, and $L=\log_2 T$; the letter $L$ changes meaning here.

symbols.name: construction constant
symbols.meaning: A construction constant of the source, with $\gamma = o(b)$.
symbols.quote: Here $\gamma$ is the construction constant of the source.

symbols.name: ring-stage error
symbols.meaning: The error of the polynomial-ring convolution stage, in units of $h_p$, bounded by $5TL$.
symbols.quote: Call this error $E_{\rm ring}$, in units of $h_p$; so $E_{\rm ring}<5TL$.

symbols.name: source-transform error
symbols.meaning: The error of the source transform stage, in units of $h_p$.
symbols.quote: The source transform contributes an error $E_s$ in units of $h_p$

symbols.name: scaled-result error
symbols.meaning: The error, in units of $h_p$, of the first scaled result before the final scalings.
symbols.quote: The first multiplication by $S$ then gives the scaled result with error $E_w$ units

relations.quote: This step bounds the error of the [Convolution over the polynomial ring](polynomial-ring-convolution.md), computed from two forward transforms, a pointwise product, and an opposite transform.
This analysis takes its guard widths from the [Guard-width bound](guard-width-bound.md), so each stored value is exact and only the stated truncations contribute error.
This analysis bounds the error of the [Phase twist](phase-twist.md) at each end of the ring map by $4h_p$, because rounding to the grid adds
This analysis bounds the norm of every operand by one, where the norm is the [Array norm](array-norm.md), the largest modulus of an entry.
For a [Bilinear map](bilinear-map.md) of two approximate operands, the error of the result sums the errors of the operands, each weighted by the norm of the other.
The stage bound includes the error of the [Opposite transform](opposite-transform.md), which inverts the forward transform up to a known factor, and of both forward transforms.
Here $T$ counts the entries of the [Padded transform box](padded-transform-box.md), a power of two in $[4n/b, 8n/b)$, and $L=\log_2 T$; the letter $L$ changes meaning here.
The final bound divides by the product $S$ of the [Prime source lengths](prime-source-lengths.md).
The bound uses the growth of $\gamma$ in the [Little-o notation](little-o-notation.md) sense: $\gamma = o(b)$.

The final scaling undoes the normalizations of the [Normalization scales](normalization-scales.md): $S$ reverses the normalization left in the first result, and $2^{2b+4}$ reverses the two input scales.
Both scaling multiplications act exactly on the integer [Grid numerator](grid-numerator.md) of each value, so they add no error of their own.
